routes.title: Two Operating Systems
routes.plain_concept: Capricorn/Aries is the doorway: he turns tomorrow into a plan, she turns the plan into today. The deck proves that different tempos become love when both partners stay active.
routes.universal_truth: Some couples do not match pace. They make pace together.
routes.aachu_spark: She starts before the room is ready, argues out loud, follows instinct, and turns order into story.
routes.zuv_role: He plans, saves receipts/screenshots, worries quietly, steadies the scene, and then admits he loves the motion she brings.
routes.proof_beat: Planner notebook/screenshots beside keys/jacket/doorway motion: his preparation becomes her runway.

routes.title: Checklist And Launch Button
routes.plain_concept: He makes the checklist; she presses start before the final box is ticked.
routes.universal_truth: Some relationships need one person to prepare and one person to begin.
routes.aachu_spark: She refuses to let planning become delay.
routes.zuv_role: He does not stop her; he quietly brings the missing pieces.
routes.proof_beat: Open checklist, half-packed bag, she already walking, he grabbing charger/wallet behind her.

routes.title: Screenshots And Instinct
routes.plain_concept: He trusts saved proof; she trusts the feeling. Their love works because evidence and instinct stop fighting and start cooperating.
routes.universal_truth: Some couples make decisions with two different kinds of confidence.
routes.aachu_spark: She reads the room with gut energy.
routes.zuv_role: He carries the backup proof without making her feel foolish.
routes.proof_beat: Phone screenshot folder versus her already pointing at the choice.

routes.title: Silent Worry, Loud Fight
routes.plain_concept: He holds worry inside; she throws feeling into the room. The story becomes how they learn each other's volume.
routes.universal_truth: People do not always love at the same volume.
routes.aachu_spark: She fights out loud because silence feels like distance.
routes.zuv_role: He names the worry through action instead of disappearing.
routes.proof_beat: Her hands mid-argument, him setting water/keys/phone down and finally meeting her eye.

routes.title: Stability And Spark
routes.plain_concept: He brings stability; she brings spark.

routes.title: He Loves The Chaos
routes.plain_concept: He acts calm but loves the chaos.
routes.universal_truth: The calm one secretly likes the dramatic one.

routes.title: Astrology Compatibility Poster
routes.plain_concept: A direct Capricorn man / Aries woman zodiac compatibility deck.
